designations.eng: Detection limit of a gas chromatograph/mass spectrometer system
designations.fra: limite de détection d'un ensemble chromatographe en phase gazeuse/spectromètre de masse

eng: Detection limit of a gas chromatograph/mass spectrometer system

terms.designation: Detection limit of a gas chromatograph/mass spectrometer system

definitions.content: The minimum amount of a specific compound which, when injected into the gas chromatograph can produce a signal-to-noise ratio of at least 10 for a characteristic molecular ion of that compound subject to the following conditions: in the full scan mode, a scan time over the appropriate mass range shall be specified; in the selected ion monitoring (SIM) mode, the principal ion characterizing the compound shall be measured. The mode of ionization (electron impact or chemical ionization) shall be considered.

notes.content: Methyl stearate is often used as the test compound.
The term "sensitivity" is frequently used to have the same meaning as this term within the community of mass spectrometer manufacturers and users.

terms.designation: limite de détection d'un ensemble chromatographe en phase gazeuse/spectromètre de masse

notes.content: Le méthyl stéarate est souvent utilisé comme composé d'essai.
Les constructeurs et utilisateurs de spectromètres de masse emploient souvent le terme « sensibilité » dans le même sens que « limite de détection ».
